workshop.message: Command "user -> authenticate" does not say which boundary it is in (add: in BoundaryName(key))
No command or policy emits: user-created, tier-created, tier-limit-increased, tier-limit-decreased, unavailable-shard-request-received. The model assumes these facts.
Read model "UserQuota" shows "remainingRequests", "resetsIn", which no event it projects from carries. Add them to an event, or compute them (name: expression)
4 of 4 commands and read models have no scenario, starting with "authenticate"

Automation on "rate-limit-reached" starts straight from the event. Write a read model such as PendingWafBot(...) fed by rate-limit-reached, and start from it: "rate-limit-reached from [PendingWafBot] -> ..." or "from [PendingWafBot] -> ..."

Automation on "unavailable-shard-request-received" starts straight from the event.
